title: Seabird streetlight lawsuit settlement
summary: On August 11, 2026, the council voted to authorize settling the seabird streetlight lawsuit brought by the Conservation Council of Hawaiʻi and the American Bird Conservancy, after discussing terms in closed session. It pulled Resolution 26-128 out of committee to act. The claim says streetlights threaten three protected seabirds; trial had been set for September 14, 2026, and mediation was set for August 10.
